file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.
file.uploadHint: A .md/.txt file becomes the body directly. A .zip is scanned for markdown/text entries only — nothing else in it is read.
file.zipCandidates: Multiple text files found in the archive — pick one:
file.zipEmpty: No markdown or text entries found in that archive.
file.success: Imported "{name}" (stored as untrusted data). It starts disabled — enable it to use it.
file.disabledNote: Imported skills are created disabled. Enable it from the Skills page or an agent's Skills tab once you have vetted it.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.
url.disabledNote: Imported skills are created disabled. Enable it from the Skills page or an agent's Skills tab once you have vetted it.
